content.text:
**Finding: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

The agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment or volume restriction on us:

- **§ 11 (Fees, p0084)** — fees are payable simply "as set out in the Fee Schedule," with no committed spend, minimum quantity or shortfall mechanic.
- **§ 2 (p0028)** — additional fees arise only if we elect to use the Software at locations beyond the Authorized Locations, i.e. usage-based rather than committed.
- **§ 10 (p0065)** — maintenance is a "renewable one-year term," not a multi-year non-cancellable subscription.
- **§ 17(b) (p0118)** — we may terminate the entire Agreement at any time on 90 days' notice, so a clean exit exists.
- Targeted searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay", "volume", "quantity" and "non-cancellable" surfaced nothing binding us (the only "commitment" hit, p0143, is the standard no-agency clause).

This satisfies the preferred position (fees for usage or ordered services only), so no edit was needed.
